key_insight: VeriFine co-evolves the policy, curriculum, and judge so verification scales with emerging failures, enabling continued self-improvement in embodied reasoning.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers a practical way to improve embodied AI systems by targeting the bottleneck of evaluation quality in driving and robot navigation.
method: Use a rubric judge to diagnose recurring failures and build an adaptive curriculum.
Trigger a Judge Improvement Loop when progress plateaus, querying humans on informative failure cases.
Refine the judge via coactive calibration so it better matches the objective rubric of physical reasoning.
evidence_signal: Experiments on driving and robot navigation show continuous self-improvement in both policy and judge capability across reinforcement learning and supervised fine-tuning.
watch_item: The approach depends on selective human guidance and careful judge calibration, so its benefits may be limited if informative failures are sparse or rubric alignment is difficult.
paper_title: VeriFine: Scaling Verification for Self-Improvement in Embodied Reasoning
